act.name: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017
act.source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
act.description: Rights-based central law covering access to mental healthcare, treatment safeguards, confidentiality and review mechanisms.

sections.title: Right to equality and non-discrimination.
sections.text: Section 21 protects equality and prohibits discrimination in mental healthcare and related services.
sections.plain_language_summary: A person with mental illness is entitled to equal treatment and statutory protection from discriminatory healthcare and insurance practices.
